description: This file defines the HomeScreen component for a recipe explorer web application using LightningJS framework. It manages state, rendering template, data loading via getRecipes, and user interaction handling such as search and keyboard navigation.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: LightningJS Component representing the main home screen with recipe grid and search functionality.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles search input, updates query state, and reloads recipes data.

methods.name: renderCard
methods.description: Renders a RecipeCard component with specified item and size, attaching onSelect handler.

methods.name: xPos
methods.description: Calculates horizontal position of a recipe card based on index.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Fetches recipes matching the current query and updates the component state.
